title: Gertrude Saunders and how Ethel Waters got her job
summary: He says Gertrude Saunders would have outshone Ethel Waters but argued with the boss, who then hired Ethel Waters.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Yeah. If she had kept her head, you would have never heard of Ethel Waters.
Is that so? What kind -- was she a good-looking chick?
Was she a good-looking black woman?
Oh, yeah. She was a brown-skinned girl.
What kind of -- what was her personality like?
She thought she was the greatest. And she got arguing with the boss and --
Her ego got to her, huh?
Yeah. And the boss told the man to get another singer.
And that's when they went out and got Ethel Waters.
Where did they get Ethel from?
